resolved_conflicts.explanation: The DNR webcam page says the 1937 tower was built to match an earlier tower on the same Pine Island site; the DNR virtual tour says it matched a tower once near campground site 1 at Big Bog. Both are reported and the record does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: The brief's record was right on county (Koochiching) and relocated status. The at-record us-mn-pine-island-at-big-bog says the 1937 tower was built 'to match an earlier tower on the same site'; that matches only the DNR webcam page, and the DNR virtual tour names a different earlier tower, so the at-record should note the disagreement. Grokipedia pages were not used because they are not a reliable source. The Pine Island site has no source describing it today; the map pages found by search show only the terrain. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the story now says the DNR pages name different towers as the model (not that they disagree on design in general), and says the DNR page reports the tower was opened, not reopened.
